path_disposition.rationale: VOS3-Cyber uniquely identifies partial brk-growth rollback and clone TID-pointer validation, but its rollback can unmap pre-existing holes and its clone-time range check does not prevent exit-time TOCTOU. The canonical clone path now clears inherited clear_child_tid before publication, rejects unsupported CHILD_SETTID, checks PARENT_SETTID usercopy, and uses the shared atomic TID allocator. Exit and fault-exit consume clear_child_tid once without directly dereferencing user memory. brk remains open: safe repair requires an address-space ownership transaction spanning demand faults, mmap, SHM and fallible SMP TLB shootdown; two reviewed prototypes were rejected rather than merged.
path_disposition.validation: Clone/TID host extraction test plus kernel build pass; native pthread/fault/SMP tests remain required. For brk, first add atomic no-replace fault claim/commit and common address reservations, then inject failure/races on every page/gap and TLB_BUSY, verify exact rollback, overflow/user-end and shrink beyond 4096 resident pages.
